prompt: Create a high-contrast black-and-white fashion illustration of a young woman with long dark hair in a high ponytail in a sophisticated hand-drawn ink-art style. Show a close-up portrait from the chest and shoulders upward, with the subject turned slightly toward the right in a confident three-quarter view, chin gently lifted, calm lips, defined eyebrows, and a poised editorial expression. She wears oversized glossy black square sunglasses with thick frames and reflective white highlights, plus a black oversized hoodie with a raised collar and two white drawstrings. Render the hair as a dramatic flowing ponytail sweeping behind her head to the left, using dense black ink, fine loose flyaway strands, sharp white highlights, and layered brush lines. Use crisp monochrome linework, deep black fills, delicate cross-hatching on the neck and shadows, subtle contour shading on the face, and clean negative space. Keep the background pure white with no text, no color, no accessories beyond small ear piercings, and no watermark. The composition should feel like a luxury streetwear fashion sketch, polished, elegant, and bold, with strong contrast between the black clothing, dark hair, sunglasses, and the bright white face and background.

promptZh: 创作一幅高对比度的黑白时尚插画，主角为 一位扎着高马尾、留着深色长发的年轻女性，采用精致的手绘水墨艺术风格。展示从胸部和肩部向上的特写肖像，主体略微向右转，呈现自信的三分之二侧面视角，下巴轻抬，双唇平静，眉形清晰，表情从容且具有时尚感。她戴着超大款亮面黑色方形太阳镜，镜框厚实且带有反光白点，身穿 一件黑色超大款连帽衫，带有立领和两条白色抽绳。头发渲染为戏剧性的飘逸马尾，向左扫向脑后，运用浓郁的黑色墨迹、细碎的飞扬发丝、锐利的白色高光以及层叠的笔触。使用清晰的单色线条、深邃的黑色填充、颈部和阴影处细腻的交叉排线、面部微妙的轮廓阴影以及干净的留白。背景保持纯白，无文字、无色彩、除小耳钉外无其他配饰，且无水印。整体构图应呈现出奢华街头时尚素描的质感，精致、优雅且大胆，黑色服装、深色头发、太阳镜与明亮的白色面部及背景之间形成强烈的对比。
